full_details: There was no rehearsal before nine, as you had set it on Friday. At the Cross Keys the two stops from Thursday were already in the book. Nick was not made to speak the speech out. Kemp was civil, and the tally was not opened. You walked the old book for the Seven Deadly Sins, which you play at two. The new comedy stayed off the yard. At dinner the loaf was still a finger short, and the string from Thursday's packet was gone. The Rose billed Faustus. You did not go. At the reckoning the gown's fifty shillings stood unpaid, against the Queen's twenty pounds, which are not had. Edith's eight shillings stood unpaid. Your twopence to the carrier stayed in your own book. John named no share. Nobody counted the coffer. At home you left the page as it was.
one_sentence: You rehearsed the old book at nine, played the Sins, and heard the fifty and the eight still owed.
title: Rehearsed the old book at nine and sat the reckoning
